sql: select a.strategy_tag, e.key as experiment, e.state, e.retired_at, v.version, ep.epoch_number, ep.ended_at as epoch_ended, d.deployment_key, d.stage, d.kind, d.started_at as dep_started, d.ended_at as dep_ended, d.grandfathered from experiment_deployment_arms a join experiment_deployments d on d.id = a.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id = ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id where a.strategy_tag in (:t1,:t2,:t3,:t4,:t5) order by a.strategy_tag, d.started_at
